jobs.occupation: Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.employer_name: PricewaterhouseCoopers GmbH WPG
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) to join our Business Services division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – You will be part of the Products & Technology team and will assume technical responsibility for the engagement management processes in the S/4HANA Public Cloud solution, ensuring a solution that is close to standard functions and industry requirements.Guidelines – You will define guidelines, standards, and the solution architecture for EM to ensure that they are in line with our future system landscape. In addition, you will evaluate S/4 HANA Public Cloud innovations and support continuous improvement.Integration – You will ensure the provision and maintenance of SAP S/4 HANA-based processes and solutions within the EM area, as well as their end-to-end integration. In addition, you will support Level 3 support and root cause analysis within S/4HANA Cloud, x-BOS solutions, and technical integration.Innovations – You evaluate and implement cloud innovations that can bring improvements through technologies such as RPA and ML.Your profile- You have completed your studies in (business) information technology, economics, or a comparable degree program.- You have several years of experience in SAP engagement management, e.g., in sales/opportunity/project management. Ideally, you have initial experience with S/4HANA Public Cloud and implementation in a multi-tenant/public cloud environment.- In addition, you ideally have knowledge of SSCUI configuration for engagement management, including sales, material master, pricing, CPM, and EPPM.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.occupation: Global Medical Manager Inflammation (Facharzt/-ärztin - Klinische Pharmakologie)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.The PositionWe at Boehringer Ingelheim Medicine share one vision: to turn patient-focused innovations into life-changing treatments. We focus on driving medical innovation, combining scientific and patient insights to develop and deliver safe and effective solutions. By concentrating on first-in-class innovations, we aim to set new standards for patient care now and for years to come.We build on the strongest of all our assets: Our people. We are an agile team with diverse skills, always striving for excellence. We embrace new technologies and trends, make use of broad data and leading analytics. Our professional ethos reflects our personal values. Above all, we are united by our passion for improving healthcare and the enduring commitment to delivering valuable solutions that transform lives today, tomorrow and beyond.Tasks & responsibilities- In your new role you act as a Global Medical Manager, Team Nerandomilast, Therapeutic Area Inflammation.- You are medically responsible for disease- and brand-related Medical Affairs activities, with a particular focus on rheumatology indications and integrated evidence generation, supporting their preparation and execution by regional/local Medicine teams.- In this context you collaborate with cross-functional teams, e.g., Clinical Development, Marketing, Market Access, Patient Advocacy Groups, Pharmacovigilance, and Regulatory Affairs, the regions providing medical input.- Furthermore, you contribute to the development & support the implementation of the Global Medical Affairs Strategy, Global Publications Plan, Core Medical Communication Points and Real-World Evidence data (RWE).- You design, review and approve studies to support clinical adoption and ensure consistency with global strategy.- In addition, you provide expertise and strategic input to allow for efficient, scientifically, and medically adequate communication in preparation for launch until the end of the product's lifecycle.- You also provide medical and scientific expertise to projects and support related activities such as educational programs, satellite symposia and communication campaigns.- Besides, you establish and provide product-specific guidance and training to regions/countries.- You maintain an external focus to ensure a good understanding of the relevant stakeholder groups for your designated asset(s) e.g., Health Authorities, External Experts, Associations, Patient groups, Payers, etc.- You understand the competitive landscape well and you provide medical input with respect to competitor landscape and scenario planning.Requirements- MD or similar degree in human health related areas- Extensive and long-term experience in Rheumatology and/or immune-mediated diseases. A minimum of 5 years of experience in evidence generation, e.g., from clinical practice, is required.- Experience in data generation beyond Boehringer sponsored clinical trials and dissemination (i.e., scientific publications)- Excellent team player with experience working in matrix teams in a country or global setting, as well as strong cross-functional collaboration skills and ability to work in virtual teams.- Excellent communication skills as well as presentation, training and facilitation skills.- Strong external focus to the international scientific community, top level medical experts and all relevant stakeholders.- Willingness to travel (up to 30% during peak times).- Full command of English Language.As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.What We OfferWith us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:The job posting is presumably online until 25.11.2026.

search, NLP, LLMs, vectors, hybrid search, machine learning are all on our roadmap, especially with performance in mind)• We're a team and do not appreciate a bus factor of 1: You have the desire to help others, share your knowledge and mentor others• You are willing to go the extra mile to make your team successful, you give honest feedback, able to discuss, commit and execute• You have excellent written and spoken English skillsBenefitsWhat we offer• Create your own work-life balance: You have the flexibility to choose between working remotely (within Germany) or from one of our locations in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in Berlin!• Urban Sports Club and RSG Group Fitness Studios : Get top deals for fitness, swimming, yoga and more• Mental Well-Being: We support you on allowances!• ‘ Deutschlandticket’: We subsidize your train season ticket for more mobility• Employee Discount: You will receive a monthly coupon for Kaufland.de• Free choice of hardware: Mac or meetings, powerful mornings, and much more!Check out our Principles & our blog for even more insights into our company culture!BewerbenDiversity at Kaufland e-commerceWe welcome applications from jobs.description: OUR COMPANYBoehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionDo you have a keen sense for navigating complex legal matters and want to contribute to securing freedom to operate and defending market exclusivity for highly innovative pharmaceuticals?Are you excited by the prospect of taking on responsibility and working in a highly dynamic environment as part of the Corporate Department of Boehringer Ingelheim being responsible for intellectual property?In this exciting position located in Ingelheim, you will play a key role in supporting our human pharma and animal health business in bringing innovative products to the patients in need.Join us to shape the future of Boehringer Ingelheim!Tasks & responsibilities- In this role, you will leverage your extensive legal expertise to mitigate launch risks from third party patents for our newly developed products as well as to enforce and defend our patents to defend our products against patent infringement.- With a strategic mindset, you will develop complex launch risk mitigation strategies in a cross functional set up and provide tailored advice to the business how to leverage upside potential from our existing patent portfolios.- Managing and instructing our network of external lawyers and patent attorneys in disputes including in-court infringement and nullity proceedings will be a key part of your responsibilities.- In addition, you will support the negotiation and drafting of complex agreements to find the best possible solutions for Boehringer Ingelheim.Requirements- Fully qualified lawyer, preferably with honors in the second state examination. An additional qualification (LL.M. or comparable degree with a focus on IP law) is desirable- Longterm specialization in the field of intellectual property and the pharmaceutical industry at an international level as well as extensive experience in managing large international IP portfolios- Longterm relevant professional experience in external law firms specialized on patent litigation or in a comparable in-house position as a corporate counsel- Experience in leading, coordinating, and managing patent litigation- Knowledge and experience in the pharmaceutical industry- Strong strategic understanding and the ability to quickly grasp and clearly present legally and technically complex matters- High level of teamwork and excellent communication skills in English and GermanWhat we offerWith us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until January 8, 2026.
